originalTitle: Reddit’s CEO says Google’s AI Mode ‘does not drive traffic’
summary: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman said in an earnings call today that Google's AI-powered search modes do not help with traffic to the platform, echoing problems facing other websites and publishers. content: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman said in an earnings call today that Google’s AI-powered search modes do not help with traffic to the platform, echoing problems facing other websites and publishers. As part of its Q3 2026 earnings, Reddit revealed that search traffic in October has “dropped by more than 1 million referrals on average per week,” and he attributes part of the company’s struggles with Google traffic to how AI Mode and AI Overviews change the search experience. “The reality is, AI Mode does not drive traffic,” Huffman says. “Not for us, and not to anybody, as far as I know. That’s just a fundamental shift in how Google works. It used to be a traffic driver, now it’s not.” He says that AI Overviews and AI Mode have “evolved a lot” and now, at a “minimum,” push “everyone down the search page.” Huffman also says that Reddit believes its content that’s machine-translated into other languages is being ranked lower in search results, which he says would primarily affect the company outside the US. However, Reddit is still a “top search term in Google,” Huffman says. “This doesn’t say anything about the internet consumers’ demand for Reddit. People still want Reddit. It says Google is not sending them to Reddit the way they used to.” He also says that Google is “crawling us as hard as ever, so the demand hasn’t changed from their point of view, either.” (Google’s business has been affected by AI Mode, too: it said yesterday that it’s seeing “lower monetization” in AI Mode ads, though it’s now bringing AI ads to more countries.) To try and combat the search referral difficulties, Reddit is working to make the platform a “direct, sticky, daily destination.” Yesterday, it introduced a “For You” feed with recommendations related to your interests, and in August, it started testing an experiment that uses AI to turn posts into short videos. Reddit also announced today that it’s going to force everyone to log in, which Huffman claims will be “better for user experience, better for our ads business, is more in line with safety regulations, and more protective of Reddit data.”

chineseContent: Reddit 首席执行官史蒂夫·霍夫曼 (Steve Huffman) 在今天的财报电话会议上表示，谷歌的人工智能搜索模式无助于增加该平台的流量，这与其他网站和出版商面临的问题相呼应。作为 2026 年第三季度收益的一部分，Reddit 透露，10 月份的搜索流量“平均每周下降了超过 100 万次推荐”，他将公司在 Google 流量方面遇到的困难部分归因于 AI 模式和 AI 概述如何改变搜索体验。 “现实是，人工智能模式不会带来流量，”霍夫曼说。 “据我所知，不适合我们，也不适合任何人。这只是谷歌运作方式的根本性转变。它曾经是交通司机，现在不是了。”他表示，人工智能概述和人工智能模式已经“发展了很多”，现在“至少”将“每个人都推向搜索页面”。霍夫曼还表示，Reddit 认为其机器翻译成其他语言的内容在搜索结果中的排名较低，他表示这将主要影响该公司在美国以外的地区。然而，赫夫曼表示，Reddit 仍然是“谷歌的热门搜索词”。 “这并没有说明互联网消费者对 Reddit 的需求。人们仍然想要 Reddit。这表明谷歌并没有像以前那样将他们发送到 Reddit。”他还表示，谷歌“一如既往地努力搜寻我们，因此从他们的角度来看，需求也没有改变。” （谷歌的业务也受到了人工智能模式的影响：它昨天表示，尽管它现在正在将人工智能广告带到更多国家，但人工智能模式广告的“货币化程度较低”。）为了尝试解决搜索推荐困难，Reddit 正在努力使该平台成为“直接的、有粘性的日常目的地”。昨天，它推出了“For You”提要，其中包含与您的兴趣相关的推荐，并于 8 月开始提供
